newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Adamjee Ins rises 0.53 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Adamjee Ins rises 0.53 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Adamjee Insurance Company's 10-rupee stock rose 0.50 rupees, or 0.53 percent, to 94 at the Karachi Stock Exchange on Sunday after the company announced a 15 percent interim dividend for the first half ended on June 30, dealers said.
They said some 500 shares changed hands in early trade.
Adamjee Insurance announced book closure from September 25 to October 2. It paid a 35 percent cash dividend and 25 percent bonus stocks for calendar 1995.
